FEE_AND_WAIVER.detail: FEE_AND_WAIVER: both fixtures (canonical b6c18f61…/13425, boundary c31fa423…/13627), filing-instructions page 5, and participant-instructions.md line 22 (FEE_AND_WAIVER row) print 'So: expect to be asked for $150, and ask the clerk's office of the Mississippi court that granted nonadjudication and entered the dismissal or closure order what that court charges for this petition before you go'. That publishes a figure to the participant as the amount to expect on a § 99-15-26(5) petition, which no held record supports: the profile's only $150 line is keyed to § 99-19-72 petitions under § 99-19-71 (A3: a line keyed to a different statute is a sibling inference), the packet itself says no bound record settles whether that fee reaches § 99-15-26(5), and owner decision Q4 (OWNER_BATCH_ADOPTION_2026-09-02, 'DO NOT PUBLISH AN UNCONFIRMED FEE … direct the participant to the specific clerk or agency for the current amount. Add a figure only when current primary authority or the official form supports it') forbids exactly this. The registry design for this remedy (legal-design-track-registry tracks[251] ms-nonadj) agrees: 'No amount is published here. Section 99-19-72's fee applies by its terms to petitions under § 99-19-71 and does not reach § 99-15-26. The participant confirms with the clerk.' Everything else in the fee section holds: it attributes the profile's § 99-19-72 lines correctly, separates § 99-15-26(5) from § 99-19-71, names the specific clerk for the amount, and says no record states a waiver (A4 holds; nothing stated is denied). Only the instruction to expect $150 is the defect. Prior PASS reads of this wording (vf03 at e10890c11, vf36 at 5c718222c) did not measure it against owner Q4; the sibling RV-02 route on the same profile (intervention-court § 99-19-71(4), VF04 PASS today) publishes no figure, and ms-fel-set now prints 0 '$150' after Q4.
